task_prompt: Fold and crease the paper sheet using both hands.
task_summary: Both hands fold the white sheet twice, crease the folds and hold the folded sheet.

objects.name: white paper sheet
properties: Thin sheet bends and folds rather than moving as one rigid solid.
A crease remains after the fingers press along the fold.
Two hands align the edges and fold the sheet into a smaller layered form.
objects.evidence: Sheet is open at 0 s, folded near 1-4 s and folded again near 5-11 s.

deformation.how_the_task_deforms_it: The hands bend the sheet along straight creases and press the layers together.

subgoals.action: Hold the paper by its edges.
subgoals.goal: The paper is held in both hands.

subgoals.action: Fold the sheet and press the first crease.
subgoals.goal: The paper is folded along a crease.

hand_roles.right: Turns the panel over and presses the crease.

subgoals.action: Fold and crease the paper again.
subgoals.goal: The paper is folded twice with the creases retained.

hand_roles.right: Folds the smaller sheet and presses the layers.

subgoals.action: Hold the folded paper while the right hand moves aside.
subgoals.goal: The paper is held in the left hand.

task_success: The paper is folded twice with the creases retained, the paper is held in the left hand.
notes: The right-hand reach toward scissors at the end is outside the requested folding task.
